description_zh: 在 US-101 南行高速公路上，前车(车辆1)因出口拥堵已减速停止，后车(车辆2)未能及时停车导致追尾碰撞。选择车辆2为 ego，因其在移动且需测试对前方静止车辆的响应。

source_snippets: Traffic in front of the autonomous test vehicle had slowed down to a stop to take this exit, causing this lane to be backed up. The driver of the autonomous vehicle applied normal braking force to come to a stop. Shortly thereafter, the autonomous test vehicle was rear-ended by a Honda -CRV.
evidence.reason: 事故为典型的追尾碰撞，前车停止，后车移动。后车（本田 CRV）作为 ego，具有测试价值（需检测能否及时刹车），符合场景表达。
